releaseNotes:
- Relationship checks now respect that nesting carries the link: a control device under equipment whose dependency is the RIO, PLC, or VFD, an RIO inside a panel under the PLC, or a VESDA nested under its fire alarm panel no longer needs to repeat that equipment as a dependency. Only rows with nothing above them or beside them pointing at the controlling equipment are flagged
- The fire alarm panel check also recognises "fire alarm control panel" and FACP
